title: Intern - RE Sector
full_description:
The Real Estate team in Italy (“RE Italy”) originates and executes business opportunities within the Real Estate sector with main focus on cash flow based financing structures. The selected candidate will join a team of 5 professionals for 6 months, supporting in the daily activities by: (i) supporting in the structuring of new transactions;  (ii) supporting the Transaction Management team during the execution phase by working on the preparation of internal ratings, cash flow models and credit analysis; (iii) liaising with Portfolio Management team for  loan monitoring tasks after financial closing, (iv) liaising with the Risk Management and Legal department and (v) when necessary, attend RE EMEA commercial committees and perform necessary related tasks.
Key Responsibilities:
Keep up to date with market, industry etc. trends and developments, analyse external reports and documentation posted on external sites, and provide team members/other stakeholders with brief summaries of the main points;
Draft internal notes and keep team members/stakeholders informed and up to date on material developments;
Analyse new financing teasers received from clients;
Attend assets site visits with other team members;
Prepare ppt presentations on new commercial proposals and any other RE related topic for internal and or external stakeholders;
Manage electronic documents and online storage of project documentation, including legal documents, borrowers' reporting information and waivers/consents related documentation;
Cross-check key reporting against data stored in the electronic document management database, and update information as and when necessary;
Perform monitoring tasks if and when required.
Educational and Work experience/ Qualifications:
University /graduate (or student close to graduation) with degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration and/or with training in financial analysis (courses on Real Estate Finance will be considered a plus)
Proven analytical skills
Good knowledge of MS Office Tools (Word, Outlook, Powerpoint) and in particular Excel
Fluency in English and Italian are a must
Major characteristics / Personal Profile:
Team working attitude
Strong interpersonal skills
Good verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work reliably and accurately under pressure
Ability to meet deadlines
Flexibility and proactive
Drive to constantly learn and improve
Location:Milan (hybrid)

Job Application Safety Reminder⚠️
We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:
Apply only via official ING platforms: ING usesWorkdayas its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted only via our official career site.
Check the sender’s email carefully: legitimate communication will always come from: @ing.com and/or @myworkday.com
No payments or banking details will ever be requested. If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.
